cost_inr_per_km_full_size.source: gross-cost-contract (GCC) per-km rates discovered in recent Indian e-bus and diesel bus tenders; engine uses 65

cost_inr_per_km_lpv.source: private minibus operating cost; no Kashmir record

diesel_kgco2_per_l.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol.2 Ch.3 default diesel factor (74,100 kg/TJ) at Indian HSD density

diesel_kmpl_full_size.source: ASRTU / CIRT State Transport Undertaking performance statistics (fleet HSD km/L); range spans city and mofussil operation

diesel_kmpl_lpv.source: manufacturer-rated economy for 12–20 seat minibuses/tempo travellers; no Kashmir record

ebus_kwh_per_km.source: reported energy intensity of 9–12 m Indian e-buses (CESL / operator disclosures)

grid_kgco2_per_kwh.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector (weighted average; high end adds T&D and charging losses)

engine_emission_factor_check.note: Engine Phase-4 Emissions_GCO2_Daily not used; e-bus factor implausibly low.
